findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hardcoded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables, exposing long-lived credentials to anyone with read access to the Lambda configuration or Terraform state. These credentials are not encrypted and can be easily leaked or misused.

The Lambda function does not specify a KMS key (kms_key_arn) for encrypting environment variables at rest, relying only on default AWS-managed encryption, which is insufficient for protecting sensitive secrets embedded in the environment block.
